name: workflow
description: Development workflow enhancements including OpenSpec proposal management, skill auto-activation, and command hooks for session checklists, type checking, and commit guards.

hooks.name: session-checklist
hooks.description: Display project status at session start (git status, commits, active changes)

hooks.name: type-checker
hooks.description: Validate TypeScript types before Edit/Write operations

hooks.name: git-commit-guard
hooks.description: Prevent auto-committing without explicit user request
